title: feat(init): auto-populate deep block in config.yml for out-of-box agent access
why:
- add discoverDeepModules(): scan top-level code files under a code_root
  (strips extension, skips test/spec/__init__, single-file root → [])
- add discoverDeep(): aggregate deep modules across all code_roots
- renderConfigYaml() now emits deep: block under component (populated when
  modules discovered; comment skeleton when not)
- 7 new tests (scan behavior, map shape, renderConfig, end-to-end init)
- full suite 459 pass, 0 fail

Existing repos: config.yml preserved on re-init (user must add deep
manually or delete config to regenerate). New repos: deep auto-filled,
so /lore:sync produces a deep page per module (overview + mechanism) and
agents can lore_page / lore_ask into them immediately.
